summary: Tested db-filter-case-type restriction to only 'Putusan Banding' and 'Peninjauan Kembali'. Backend GET /api/putusan with case_type filter works correctly (banding regex matches only Banding; PK returns []; no filter returns all). Frontend select has exactly 2 selectable options with placeholder disabled+hidden. Banding filter renders only Banding items (5), PK shows empty message, Reset button appears and restores list. Year+case_type combo regression passes. Backend 4/4 pytest passed. One minor race-condition observed in UI (initial unfiltered fetch from goToDatabase occasionally resolves AFTER filter fetch, briefly leaving a stale non-Banding item visible), but functional outcome of the feature is correct.

integration_issues.issue: Race condition: loadDatabase() is invoked by goToDatabase() with no filter (returns 6) and may resolve AFTER applyDbPutusanFilter()'s request (returns 5), causing stale non-Banding item to briefly appear in Putusan list. Deterministic test triggered the leak on first automated run; manual/slower interaction is fine. Low priority.

action_items: (Optional, low priority) Cancel/ignore stale loadDatabase response when a newer filter request is in-flight (e.g., AbortController or request sequence id) to prevent the brief stale-item flash when switching to Tax Database and immediately picking a filter.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py list_putusan case_type regex approach (keyword 'banding'/'peninjauan') is a solid, case-insensitive match that correctly excludes 'Putusan Pajak' fallback entries from the 'Putusan Banding' filter.
server.py grew past 700+ lines — consider splitting putusan/peraturan/branding/export into submodules.
App.js is ~1k+ lines in a single component — splitting Home into feature components (TaxDatabase, TaxKnowledge, PutusanWorkspace) would improve maintainability.
loadDatabase has no request-cancellation; concurrent calls can produce out-of-order state updates (see integration_issue).
context_for_next_testing_agent: db-filter-case-type now exposes only 2 selectable options (Putusan Banding, Peninjauan Kembali). Backend regex case-insensitive on 'banding'/'peninjauan' keywords works correctly and is covered by /app/backend/tests/test_putusan_case_type_filter.py.
rca of the issue: N/A — all requested behaviors verified. Only observation: loadDatabase() lacks request de-duplication which can produce a stale UI flash when goToDatabase and applyDbPutusanFilter fire in quick succession.
